8. The Mythical Man-Month in the Age of AI

Source: HackerNews | Topic: hn | Coverage: 1 source | Discussion

Summary

This article explores the relevance of Fred Brooks' 'The Mythical Man-Month' in the context of modern AI-assisted software development. It examines whether AI tools can mitigate the communication overhead and productivity bottlenecks described in the original 1975 text. The analysis questions if adding more AI agents to a project produces the same diminishing returns as adding more human developers.

My Take

We’ve spent fifty years proving that adding more people to a late project just makes it later, so naturally, we’re now trying to see if adding more AI agents will break the space-time continuum. Spoiler alert: the bottleneck isn't the code, it's the humans trying to coordinate the mess. No amount of LLMs can fix a team that doesn't know what it's building.
